name: Awakening
sub: The tutorial: learn to move like light.

levels.name: First Light
levels.hint: Swipe along a wall to slide. Past the edge you keep flying until you hit the next wall.

levels.name: Angles
levels.hint: Violet ramps mirror your flight 90 degrees. You can't stick to their slanted side.

levels.name: Kick
levels.hint: Pink launch pads: TAP (or Space) to kick straight off them, away from the wall.

levels.name: Event Horizon
levels.hint: Black holes bend your flight - get too close and you're swallowed. You're safe while stuck to a wall.

levels.name: Phantom Run
levels.hint: Everything at once: ramps, a pad and a black hole. Follow the shards - and use the hole's pull.

name: The Abyss
sub: Total darkness. Your light shows the way.

levels.name: Reflections
levels.hint: Silver mirrors bounce your light - you can't cling to them. Diagonal mirrors turn you 90°.

levels.name: Drift
levels.hint: Neon platforms slide on their tracks. Stick to one and ride it - then time your launch.

levels.name: Solar Flare
levels.hint: Stars burn. Their glow lights the dark - just don't touch them.

levels.name: Murk
levels.hint: Gas clouds swallow light. Faint outlines show where they drift.

levels.name: Event Horizon
levels.hint: Everything at once. Read the light, then move.

levels.name: Singularity
levels.hint: Ride the drift, catch the mirror - and mind the star.

levels.name: Deep Descent
levels.hint: Three dark chambers stacked high. Let ramps and mirrors carry you upward.

levels.name: Lightless Corridor
levels.hint: A long dark hall. Mirrors turn you, the black hole bends your path, launch pads kick you off the edge.

levels.name: Heart of the Abyss
levels.hint: Grand finale - only 3 lives! Stars burn and black holes swallow. Climb all four chambers.

name: Solar Winds
sub: Bright skies, solar winds and stardust. The world grows!

levels.name: Tailwind
levels.hint: Solar winds push your light. Ride the updraft - then let the breeze carry you home. The view follows you!

levels.name: Quarter Pipe
levels.hint: Glowing curved walls swing you around the bend and launch you at boosted speed.

levels.name: Bullet Time
levels.hint: Gravity wells slow time for everything - use the slow-mo to time your ride.

levels.name: Crosswind Circuit
levels.hint: Only a boosted photon can punch through a headwind. Chain the pipes!

levels.name: Solar Crown
levels.hint: The grand finale: loop the arena, catch the lift, and ride the river of light.

levels.name: Updraft Tower
levels.hint: Climb the tower: let the quarter-pipes fling you up and around the walls.

levels.name: Jet Stream
levels.hint: A long run east. Pipes boost you, winds push you, wells slow time.

levels.name: Solar Summit
levels.hint: Grand finale - only 3 lives! Pipes, winds, wells and crushing platforms all the way up.

name: Rocks from Space
sub: Deep space. Asteroids, dust rings and cosmic hail.

levels.name: Stone Drift
levels.hint: Asteroids! Their glowing rims shatter light. Watch each rock drift on its track, then dash past.

levels.name: Dust Rings
levels.hint: Rings of space dust spin around calm eyes. Thread a gap, rest in the eye, then slip out.

levels.name: Cosmic Hail
levels.hint: Cosmic hail! Lanes shimmer red just before a barrage. Cross in the calm, shelter under ledges.

levels.name: Meteor Crossing
levels.hint: Rocks, rings and hail together. Read the rhythm of each hazard before you leap.

levels.name: Starfall
levels.hint: The finale: ride the curves around the rock belt, through the hail and into the rings.

levels.name: Meteor Shaft
levels.hint: A tall shaft of drifting rocks and hail. Watch the rhythm before every leap.

levels.name: Rock Garden
levels.hint: A long run east through a field of drifting rocks. Time each leap between them.

levels.name: Asteroid Gauntlet
levels.hint: Grand finale - only 3 lives! Rocks, rings and hail in every chamber.

name: Song of Rainbows
sub: Cheerful skies. Rainbow paths, prisms and rain clouds.

levels.name: Rainbow Road
levels.hint: Touch a rainbow while moving along it and you snap on and ride it to the end. Swipe up into one!

levels.name: Prism Light
levels.hint: Fly through a prism to split your light and take its colour. Coloured glass only lets matching light through.

levels.name: Rain Dance
levels.hint: Fly through a rain cloud to burst it. After the rain, a hidden rainbow appears!

levels.name: Colour Storm
levels.hint: Rainbows can carry you through prisms. Change colour mid-flight to slip through the glass.

levels.name: Song of Rainbows
levels.hint: The finale: every colour, every cloud, every rainbow. Sing your way to the top!

levels.name: Colour Cascade
levels.hint: Three sky gardens, each locked by coloured glass. Find the right prism, then ride the rainbows up.

levels.name: Thunder Meadow
levels.hint: A friendly storm! A lightning lane darkens and sparkles before a bolt. Cross while the sky is calm.

levels.name: Rainbow's End
levels.hint: Grand finale - only 3 lives! Prisms, gates, rain clouds and lightning on the way to the end of the rainbow.

name: Frozen Light
sub: An ice world. Lanterns, glaciers, waterfalls and sunlight.

levels.name: Lantern Light
levels.hint: Fly past a lantern to light it. Its warm glow melts the matching ice.

levels.name: Sun Through Ice
levels.hint: Sunlight shining through the ice makes you BIG. Big light smashes glaciers!

levels.name: Waterfall
levels.hint: Fly through a waterfall and you shrink. Small light slips through cracks in the ice.

levels.name: Thaw and Shatter
levels.hint: Get big to break the glacier, light the lantern, then shrink to squeeze through the crack.

levels.name: Frozen Light
levels.hint: Shrink, light, grow, smash, shrink again: carry the light all the way through the ice.

levels.name: Glacier Climb
levels.hint: Light the lantern to melt the ice, then catch the sunlight and smash through the glacier.

levels.name: Icicle Hollow
levels.hint: Icicles shiver before they fall. Let them drop, then dash under. Shrink to slip through the crack.

levels.name: Heart of Winter
levels.hint: Grand finale - only 3 lives! Lanterns, glaciers, cracks and falling icicles all the way up.
